text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even in victory, Mejiro Ardan was left 
deeply impressed by the terrifying prowess 
of Oguri Cap and the others. Together, 
they pledged to settle the score at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Yaeno Muteki called out Mejiro 
Ardan and Sakura Chiyono O, handing them 
both a letter of challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a proposal to settle the score 
alongside Oguri Cap at the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) and show the world who the true 
Big Three really were.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's heart leapt at Yaeno 
Muteki's proposal. Beneath the setting 
sun, the three of them vowed to settle who 
was top among them at the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).
